The plate is about 360 px across, so I treat it as roughly 26 cm. That gives about 14 px per cm.

The food mound is about 190 px wide, which is roughly 13 cm. It is about 150 px tall, or roughly 10 cm. It looks like rice or a grain mixed with diced tomato, topped with a green salsa or sauce, and possibly some shrimp or chicken pieces. The layer is fairly thin, perhaps 2-3 cm thick.

Estimated volume is about 100 cm² of footprint × 2.5 cm ≈ 250 cm³. At a loose density of about 0.7 g/cm³, that is about 175 g of food.

Cooked rice with vegetables and sauce comes to about 1.5 kcal/g, so 175 g is about 260 kcal. Allowing for a little oil in the sauce, I'll round up slightly.
